enabled.title: Show the notice bar
enabled.description: Off: the bar is not shown anywhere and GET /v1/notice answers null; your text, link and dates are kept for next time.

text.title: Notice text
text.description: Shown in the bar while the dates say so; empty shows nothing.

linkUrl.title: Link address
linkUrl.description: An https address or a path on your website.

startsAt.title: Show from
startsAt.description: An ISO 8601 time such as 2026-11-20T00:00:00Z; empty shows it at once.

endsAt.title: Show until
endsAt.description: An ISO 8601 time; empty keeps it until you change it.

dismissible.title: Visitors can close it
dismissible.description: Shows a close button; how long a closed bar stays closed is set below.

dismissFor.title: A closed bar stays closed
dismissFor.description: Visit: for the rest of the visit. Page: until the visitor opens another page.

hideOnPages.title: Hide on pages
hideOnPages.description: Path patterns where the bar is not shown, each starting with / (/ is the home page): * is any characters inside one segment, ** any number of segments (for example /checkout/** or /sale-*). At most 50.
